dependency.bulk_momentum_constraint: [T_bulk,n nu] supplies the same Ward source
dependency.identity: D^mu J_mu_nu=-[T_bulk,n nu] after intrinsic Bianchi

Noether_Bianchi.identity_role: relates R_perp to bulk normal constraints and independent B1/scalar/matcher equations; it does not set R_perp to zero before those equations are solved
Noether_Bianchi.reason: xi^t|B1!=0 does not preserve the fixed abstract support

Z2.scalar_sign_s: absent at linear order because sigma0=0
Z2.tau: changes the linear source sign, not the dependency rank

equivalent_routes.Noether: boundary coefficient in the five-dimensional diffeomorphism identity for xi^A=zeta n^A
equivalent_routes.normal_system: normal projection of the cap Einstein constraints plus the contraction of the tensor junction with the background extrinsic curvature and scalar/matcher boundary equations
equivalent_routes.shape: diagnostic shape derivative of P1+GHY+B1+matcher+scalar without adding zeta to the configuration space

homogeneous_order.O(q): zero on the stored homogeneous bulk and junction tangent

normal_support_residual.linearized_structure: R_perp^(1)=sum_caps c_H delta E_nn+Kbar^(mu nu)delta J_mu_nu+terms proportional to the scalar and matcher boundary equations

local_orders.O((Dq)^2): present beyond linear order and additionally depends on ell2,a2,N2 and constraint corrections
local_orders.O(D2q): enters delta K_mu_nu through +tau(chi_1/4)t D_muD_nu q at the fold
local_orders.O(Dq): enters the shift one-form but cannot form R_perp alone

normal_support_residual.missing_object: the action-normalized time-dependent spatially homogeneous threading contribution to the scalar B1 junction projections and endpoint trace
normal_support_residual.normalization_status: the coefficient c_H and complete endpoint terms require the unexpanded fixed-support quadratic action; no arbitrary normalization is assigned
normal_support_residual.primary_definition: R_perp[q]=(sqrt|h|)^-1 delta_zeta^diag S_total|zeta=0, where delta_zeta^diag is a diagnostic simultaneous normal domain displacement and field pullback, not a varied field
normal_support_residual.why_v6_18_insufficient: v6.18 derives K_Sigma=(2/a^2)D_spatial^2 on round S3 and C_Sigma=0; it does not derive D_0D_0 q or the Lorentzian homogeneous endpoint response
